name: setns-from-container
description: setns(2) invoked by a non-runtime process inside a container (enrichment.container_id resolved). This is the primary namespace-escape mechanism: the process reassociates with a host namespace via /proc/1/ns/*. Identity fields confirm container-scoped namespace IDs (non-host ns_mnt/ns_pid). Expect alert from container-escape-namespace-switch.
